description: Get the organisation-managed fields that a workspace is restricted from including in log exports. Use before create_log_export or update_log_export to avoid requesting disallowed fields. Requires an API key with logs.export scope; completion-log fields may additionally require completion scope. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID whose export field restrictions should be read

name: get_log_export_field_restrictions

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
